messages:
olga: Follow-up from the metering postmortem: we need a simple owner matrix, a reproducible reconciliation query, and a timetable for the backfill + invoice adjustments. Keeping this thread as the canonical checklist.

ben: I can own the backfill orchestration. Plan: dry-run on read-replica, sample-verify 150 accounts, then apply to prod during ops window. Will add an idempotency key at ingest to prevent duplicated events.

maria: I'll take the invoice adjustments and the credits ledger entries. Please provide the reconciled CSV with delta so accounting can audit. Format requested: customer_id, billed_tokens, reconciled_tokens, delta_tokens, unit_price_usd, suggested_credit_usd, review_flag.

olga: Canonical reconciliation query for replica run (v2 table):
```
SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) AS reconciled_tokens
FROM billing.token_ledger_v2
WHERE event_time >= '2026-03-10' AND event_time < '2026-03-17'
GROUP BY customer_id;
```
Ben 11: run this on replica and attach CSV gist.

ben: Dry-run scheduled Thu 06:30 UTC on replica. I'll post gist link and a short sample diff. If dry-run matches expectations I'll open PR for the hotfix (including idempotency guard) and a staging patch for smoke tests.

ops-bot: Reminder: request maintenance window for production backfill. Include exact start/end and rollback plan.

maria: Credit calc: suggested_credit_usd = ROUND(MAX(0, billed_tokens - reconciled_tokens) * unit_price_usd, 2). Set review_flag = true when delta_tokens / billed_tokens > 0.015 OR delta_tokens > 2500. That will surface accounts for manual review.

olga: Also adding an automated alert: weekly job to compare ledger ingest lag and token variance. Alert triggers when ingest_lag > 60 minutes AND population_delta > 0.5%. Maria 11: please add runbook steps and the contact list for support escalation.

maria: Will add runbook and a support reply template. Draft message: "We detected a metering delay affecting usage reporting for Mar 10-16. We've reconciled your usage and issued any applicable credits. See attached details; reply if you need escalation"

ben: For safety, backfill will include a pre-check: confirm total_tokens_post_backfill >= total_tokens_current and checksum on sample accounts. If pre-check fails, abort and rollback.

olga: Owners & timeline: ben = backfill & hotfix PR, maria = credits + support messaging, olga = postmortem doc updates and validation. Timeline: dry-run Thu, PR for staging Thu night, prod run Mon 03/16 03:15 UTC pending ops approval, credits posted Tue. Weekly sync until all credits cleared and alert has run twice.

acct-bot: Accounting note: once CSV uploaded, attach GL impact estimate. Also tag for audit review.

maria: ETA for CSV with suggested credits and review flags: Fri EOD. I'll produce both the full CSV and a short prioritized review list.

ben: I'll include unit tests for the idempotency guard and a small integration smoke test for the backfill path.

olga: Great. I'll update the postmortem with owners/PR links and schedule the weekly checkpoints. Closing this thread after the first prod run is verified. Thanks all.
